name: President
source:
She is the president of the company in which [url=/c68619]Keisuke[/url] works. She is a mature woman with a strong personality: her employees know they can count on her. However, she has a very nasty flaw because she tends to sexually harass her subordinates.

The President has been married in the past but is now divorced. However, she says that her husband had an excellent wiggle...

[spoiler]Despite her divorce, it is said that she still keeps in touch with his ex-husband and that they see each other regularly. According to her, it's because of him that she doesn't like Maids Cafés. It is suggested that they are still in love with each other.[/spoiler]
